commit.merge_subject: merge: library rows refresh, uniform slots, divider

description:
Three owner findings on the Library list after the thumbnail
rotation feature (da763c9):

1. Icon did not refresh live after rotation. Returning from the
   editor is a fresh Library composition, so the bounded backfill
   DID regenerate the icon on the current visit (~1s) — but the
   row never recomposed to show it: thumbnailAt is a plain
   composition-time read, and an already-probed rotated clip's
   record does not change, so no state write invalidated the row
   (only the next enter-exit picked the file up). AppNav now keeps
   a thumbnailRevision counter bumped after every generation pass
   (rotation backfill, import, relink — one line each path);
   LibraryScreen pins each row's thumbnailAt read to it with
   remember(thumbnailRevision), so the bump re-reads the store
   and the fresh path re-runs the row's own decode: placeholder
   swaps to icon in place, no re-entering the e
changed: fix: library rows refresh, uniform slots, divider
